newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Water sees Q4 charge $0.28/shr.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Water sees Q4 charge $0.28/shr.

text.p: Consumers Water Co said Monday it will take an after-tax charge in the fourth quarter of $2.4 million, or $0.28 per share, from the reorganization of its subsidiary, Consumers Applied Technologies Inc.
After the charge, Consumers Applied's loss for 1996 is expected to be $3.4 million, the company said.
About half of the charge is related to restructuring, while the balance is from exiting two lines of business deemed "no longer appropriate," the company said.
Consumers Applied is consolidating some operations to its Orlando, Fla., office. It is getting out of the environmental business and refocusing its water-meter installation business.
Consumers Applied will operate out of its Wallingford, Conn., and Orlando offices.
